Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

Thank you for your prompt response and for presenting such a comprehensive proposal for our fastener requirements. We truly value our long-standing partnership with you and appreciate the competitive pricing for the requested volume. To secure a more favorable price structure, we are interested in bundling the entire kit with a single distributor; please let us know if this consolidation allows us to extend the contract term or improve the unit cost.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 5.25, payment_days 45, contract_months 24; unit_price 5.27, payment_days 60, contract_months 24; unit_price 5.22, payment_days 14, contract_months 24). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome the opportunity to bundle the entire kit and are pleased to extend the contract term to 24 months.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. For our main Angebot, we are pleased to present a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

As an alternative option, for a 24-month contract with 45-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.55 per unit with a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

To accurately calculate the pricing impact of this consolidation, we kindly request the specific volume figures you expect. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to present our offer of a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We appreciate your readiness to commit to the required volume, but we still require the specific figures to accurately finalize the pricing structure. In response to your proposal for a 30-day payment term over a 24-month contract, we can offer a revised price of €5.48 per unit, with a price of €5.48 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please provide the exact volume you intend to order so that we may proceed accordingly. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
